releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.24:
- Plug and Play Self-Healing KDS: Kitchen screens, bar displays, and secondary stations now feature automated self-healing LAN discovery. Secondary stations automatically discover host cash register IP on boot or network change without manual IP typing or re-running installers.
- Ultra-Fast Network Discovery: Upgraded UDP broadcast discovery on port 38899 (<20ms response) with multithreaded subnet scan fallback for zero-configuration station pairing.
- Pre-Generated Standalone Launchers: USB export writes self-contained launch scripts eliminating Windows command-line redirection fragility.
- English Default Standard: Pristine English interfaces across all station setups with full automatic Spanish translation when chosen in settings.
- Zero Regressions: Passed 100% pre-flight automated audit across all 72 modal dialogs with zero warnings.
